Game Overview

Stealth Sprint - Ninja Run is a jumping game built around sprint through the night as a nimble ninja, evading traps and leaping across rooftops. Test your reflexes in an endless challenge where only the sharp-minded survive. Unleash secret powers, beat high scores, and prove your stealth prowess. Are you ready to conquer the shadows?
